name: @gtm-validator/analysis
description: Startup idea GTM analysis, real-world signals, adversarial review, and build blueprints
author: Rohin Bhargava

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist lib pnpm.lock.yaml tsconfig.tsbuildinfo node_modules
scripts.dev: pnpm migrate:up && pnpm tsx watch server.ts
scripts.dev:local: DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.local pnpm migrate:up && DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.local pnpm tsx watch server.ts
scripts.migrate:init: if [ ! -f migrations/Migration* ]; then [ -z $DOTENV_FILE_PATH ] && export DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.local; NODE_OPTIONS='--import=tsx' mikro-orm migration:create --initial; fi
scripts.start: [ -f .env.prod ] && export DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.prod; pnpm migrate:up && [ -f .env.prod ] && export DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.prod; node --import=tsx dist/server.js
scripts.start:server: [ -f .env.prod ] && export DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.prod; pnpm migrate:up && [ -f .env.prod ] && export DOTENV_FILE_PATH=.env.prod; node --import=tsx dist/server.js
